primary_endpoint: NASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis at 52 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: NASH resolution: placebo 8.7%, icosabutate 300 mg 17.3% (p=0.2991) and 600 mg 20.8% (p=0.1386); neither dose differed significantly from placebo.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: placebo 4/91 (1 death), 300 mg 5/92 (0 deaths), 600 mg 8/95 (1 death).
